slides.headline: Meshy plugged its AI into a chat assistant
body: Meshy is one of the biggest AI 3D-modeling tools: you type a description or upload a picture, and it builds a 3D model.
This week it released a plugin for Hermes Agent, a free, open-source AI assistant from Nous Research. You chat with Hermes, and Hermes runs Meshy for you.

slides.headline: Chat in, 3MF out
hits: You describe the part or figure in plain English
It checks for print problems and repairs them
Scales it to real size, exports a 3MF for your slicer

slides.headline: AI models usually fail as prints
body: Holes in the mesh, paper-thin walls and random scale make most AI models a pain to print. This plugin fixes those before you ever open your slicer.
Cost: the plugin is free. Making models needs a paid Meshy plan.
slides.take: Print prep is the missing piece for AI models. If the repairs hold up, this is a big deal.
